facebook.long_form:
📅 Five days. That's all that stands between us and the 2026-27 NBA schedule.

Here's what we know: the NBA Cup (Emirates NBA Cup) slate drops first on Tuesday, August 11. Then the full 1,230-game regular-season schedule arrives Thursday, August 13. The 81st NBA season tips off October 20.

But here's what we DON'T know yet — and what we're desperately waiting to find out:

**The Knicks' banner night.** The defending champions will raise their 2025-26 championship banner at Madison Square Garden on October 20. The question is who's coming to crash that party. That opponent gets the most-watched opener in the Eastern Conference.

**LeBron's first game in Philadelphia.** He signed with the Sixers. Joel Embiid declared himself healthy. Jaylen Brown came over from Boston. Tyrese Maxey has been in the gym at 6 AM. The Sixers have everything. Now we find out where this story begins.

**Christmas Day matchups.** LeBron has played in 16 consecutive Christmas Day games. At age 41, with a 76ers team that has five combined MVP awards in its starting five, who does the league send them against on Christmas?

**Wemby vs. Embiid.** Two of the most dominant big men in NBA history on the same calendar — when do we get the marquee showdowns?

The league has also been building buzz around six new head coaches and how their teams slot into the national TV calendar.

It has been a dramatic offseason. Thursday is when the actual season finally starts to feel real.

💬 What's the first game you're circling when the schedule drops? Let us know below.

stories.title: Kawhi Leonard — NBPA Arbitration Threat, Trade Frozen as Investigation Hits 11 Months
stories.angle: The NBA's investigation into the Clippers/Kawhi Leonard salary cap probe is now 11 months old. The NBPA has stated it "wouldn't hesitate" to demand neutral arbitration if the league pursues penalties without sufficient evidence. The most likely outcome remains a negotiated settlement — but every day without one pushes the Raptors trade deeper into limbo.

facebook.long_form:
⚖️ The Kawhi Leonard saga has entered a new phase — and it's not going away anytime soon.

The NBA's investigation into the Los Angeles Clippers for alleged salary cap circumvention is now 11 months old. The probe centers on a secret endorsement deal between Leonard and Daktronics, a scoreboard company, which the Clippers allegedly facilitated to get around his salary cap number.

Here's where things stand as of today:

**The trade:** Agreed to on approximately June 30. Kawhi Leonard goes to Toronto in exchange for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, and two unprotected first-round picks (2031 and 2033). The deal is currently frozen — the NBA told the Raptors they'd assume the risk of any investigation outcome if they choose to proceed before the probe concludes.

**The threat:** The NBPA has stated it "wouldn't hesitate" to demand that the matter go to a neutral arbitrator if the league pursues penalties without, in the union's view, sufficient evidence. An arbitration ruling would then be subject to a binding three-person appeals panel jointly appointed by the NBA and NBPA. That process doesn't have a hard deadline — which means this could realistically drag into 2027.

**The most likely outcome:** Multiple insiders — including reporters at ESPN and CBS Sports — say the most likely resolution remains a negotiated settlement between the NBA and the Clippers. That path would allow the trade to finally proceed, with both the Clippers and Raptors publicly maintaining that they intend to complete the deal.

So where does that leave Kawhi? He is owed $50.3 million in the 2026-27 season. He is effectively a Clipper with nowhere to play until this is resolved. Training camp opens in approximately seven weeks.

The clock is ticking — very slowly.

💬 How does this end? Does the trade eventually go through, or does something break down entirely? Share your prediction.

stories.title: Stephen Curry Extension Window Opens August 29 — $136.7M Max Expected
stories.angle: Curry's extension window officially opens August 29 (not Aug 6 as earlier reported). Confirmed mutual interest; Warriors ready to offer full 2yr/$136.7M max. Curry plans to stay for the full 2026-27 season regardless. A September signing is widely expected.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Stephen Curry's extension window opens August 29.

The Warriors are ready to offer the full 2-year, $136.7M max.

Curry has no interest in a trade. A September signing is widely expected.

At 38, he's finishing his career in Golden State. #Warriors #NBA

facebook.long_form:
🏆 Mark your calendars: August 29.

That's when Stephen Curry officially becomes eligible to sign a two-year, $136.7 million contract extension with the Golden State Warriors. And by all accounts, that's exactly what's about to happen.

Multiple reports confirm mutual interest between Curry and the Warriors. If Curry wants the full $136.7 million — carrying him through the 2028-29 season, his age-40 year — Golden State is prepared to offer it. A September signing is widely expected.

Let's be clear about what this extension means:

**For the Warriors:** It keeps the greatest shooter in NBA history — who also happens to be the most important player in franchise history — signed through at least age 40. Golden State doesn't have a version of relevance that doesn't include Stephen Curry. Locking him in, even at $68M per year, is straightforward.

**For Curry:** He is choosing to finish his career in Golden State. He has no interest in requesting a trade or testing free agency. Without this extension, he would become an unrestricted free agent next summer for the first time in his career. He is not taking that risk — and the Warriors are not letting him walk.

**The fine print:** Some have floated the idea that Curry might take a slight discount to give Golden State more cap flexibility to build around him. ESPN's Brian Windhorst has explored alternative extension structures. The standard max appears most likely, but the final number isn't locked until signing day.

Golden State finished 37-45 last season. Draymond Green is back on a one-year, $27.7M deal. Gary Payton II re-signed for $3.9M. The roster construction around Curry for 2026-27 is still developing — but the foundation is clear.

Stephen Curry. Warriors. At least through age 40.

💬 Do you think Curry takes the full max, or does he leave something on the table to help the Warriors build a contender? Sound off below.

stories.title: Wembanyama and Spurs Staff Head to Paris — France vs. Serbia Looms
stories.angle: It's not just teammates — Spurs coaches and staff joined Victor Wembanyama in Paris for summer workouts, a significant organizational investment. France opens against Serbia in exhibitions Aug 20 and 23, then faces World Cup qualifiers against Slovenia (Aug 27) and Sweden (Aug 30). New coach Frederic Fauthoux leads the French national team for the first time with Wemby on the roster.

World Cup qualifiers: Aug 27 + 30

Wemby said it best: "I miss FIBA."

#Spurs #NBA #Wembanyama

facebook.long_form:
🇫🇷 The San Antonio Spurs just sent their entire basketball operation to Paris.

Not just teammates — coaches and staff made the trip to join Victor Wembanyama for his summer camp in France. It is an unusual and significant organizational commitment, the kind that tells you exactly how the Spurs view this offseason: as a chance to build something real before training camp begins.

Wembanyama is getting ready to return to the French national team for the first time since the 2024 Paris Olympics, where France pushed the United States to the final moments of the gold medal game. Now he's preparing for the next chapter of international basketball under new head coach Frederic Fauthoux — who took over the French program after the Paris Games in September 2024.

This will be the first time Fauthoux coaches Wembanyama with the senior national team. France's August schedule:

**August 20:** Exhibition vs. Serbia in Belgrade
**August 23:** Exhibition vs. Serbia in Orleans
**August 27:** FIBA World Cup 2027 qualifier vs. Slovenia (home)
**August 30:** FIBA World Cup 2027 qualifier at Sweden (away)

Wembanyama's French roster includes Rudy Gobert and Evan Fournier — Fournier making his first appearance with France since the Paris Games.

Wembanyama has been characteristically understated about the whole thing. His quote on returning to international basketball: "I do not miss the NBA right now. I miss FIBA basketball."

He spent eight years developing as a youth player at a basketball court in Nanterre — a court that was recently renovated, and whose reopening he attended before the national team camp. He is, in every sense, home.

The FIBA window is 12 days away. The NBA season is 73 days away. For Wembanyama, August is one long competition.

💬 Can France reach the 2027 FIBA World Cup finals with Wembanyama leading the way? What's your prediction?

stories.title: Embiid Slims Down — LeBron Reacts, 76ers Chemistry Keeps Building
stories.angle: Joel Embiid posted a viral photo showing a noticeably slimmer physique this offseason. LeBron James reacted publicly online. The 76ers — already doing 6 AM workouts — are building the kind of chemistry that championship runs are made of before camp even opens.

LeBron James reacted publicly.

The 76ers are already locked in. #Sixers #NBA

facebook.long_form:
🏀 The Philadelphia 76ers might be the most interesting team in the NBA right now — and they haven't played a single game yet.

This week, Joel Embiid posted a photo showing a noticeably slimmer physique heading into the 2026-27 season. LeBron James saw it and reacted publicly online.

If Embiid's fitness has been the one remaining question mark around the Sixers' historic collection of talent, this week offered the most compelling evidence yet that he's taking it seriously.

Think about the context:

Embiid has been plagued by knee and health issues throughout his career. The 76ers have consistently underperformed relative to their paper talent, and Embiid's availability has often been the single biggest variable. When LeBron made the call to sign in Philadelphia — calling it his "last decision" as a free agent — he did so knowing this. He chose Philly because he believed in what Embiid could be when healthy.

Now Embiid is visibly leaner. LeBron has reacted. And before any of that, Tyrese Maxey was already in the gym beating LeBron to the 6 AM workout.

The projected starting five for Philadelphia: LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, Jaylen Brown, and VJ Edgecombe. That group holds five combined NBA MVP awards.

Embiid publicly declared himself healthy and ready for Day 1 in late July. The coaching staff confirmed his health status. And now — with a viral offseason photo and LeBron's public endorsement — the culture piece is beginning to match the talent piece.

Training camp opens in late September. The schedule drops Thursday. The regular season begins October 20.

The 76ers look like a team that knows exactly what's at stake.

💬 Is Joel Embiid's fitness the X-factor for the 76ers' championship chances? How healthy does he need to be for this team to compete in the East?
